using namespace std;

int main() {
    int a;
    cin >> a;
    string s1;
    cin >> s1;
    // convert to lowercase
    for (char &c : s1) c = tolower(c);
    string s2 = s1; // not used further
    // stack
    stack<char> st;
    for (char c : s1) st.push(c);
    // list of indices of '(' and ')'
    vector<int> list;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s1.length(); ++i) {
        if (s1[i] == '(') {
            st.pop();
            list.push_back(i);
        }
        if (s1[i] == ')') {
            st.pop();
            list.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    // map from opening to closing
    map<int,int> mp;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)list.size(); i += 2) {
        mp[list[i]] = list[i+1];
    }
    // list3: all indices inside parentheses
    vector<int> list3;
    for (auto &p : mp) {
        for (int j = p.first; j <= p.second; ++j) {
            list3.push_back(j);
        }
    }
    // c: characters outside parentheses
    int outsideSize = s1.length() - list3.size();
    string c(outsideSize, ' ');
    int in = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s1.length(); ++i) {
        if (find(list3.begin(), list3.end(), i) == list3.end()) {
            c[in++] = s1[i];
        }
    }
    // c2: characters inside parentheses with spaces
    int insideSize = list3.size();
    string c2(insideSize, ' ');
    int in2 = 0;
    bool b = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s1.length(); ++i) {
        if (find(list3.begin(), list3.end(), i) != list3.end()) {
            if (s1[i] == '(' || s1[i] == ')' || s1[i] == '_') {
                if (b) {
                    c2[in2++] = ' ';
                    b = false;
                }
            } else {
                c2[in2++] = s1[i];
                b = true;
            }
        }
    }
    // pan from c2
    string pan = "";
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)c2.length(); ++i) {
        pan += c2[i];
    }
    // split pan by spaces
    vector<int> list5;
    stringstream ss(pan);
    string token;
    while (ss >> token) {
        if (!token.empty()) {
            list5.push_back(token.length());
        }
    }
    // outside processing
    string str = regex_replace(s1, regex(R"(\(.*?\) ?)"), " ");
    // replace underscores with spaces
    for (char &ch : str) if (ch == '_') ch = ' ';
    // split str by spaces
    vector<int> list8;
    stringstream ss2(str);
    while (ss2 >> token) {
        if (!token.empty()) {
            list8.push_back(token.length());
        }
    }
    sort(list8.begin(), list8.end());
    if (list8.empty()) {
        cout << 0;
    } else {
        cout << list8.back();
    }
    cout << " " << list5.size();
    return 0;
}
